positions.title: Cap on liability
positions.standard: Each party's aggregate liability is capped at the fees paid in the twelve (12) months before the claim.

fallbacks.text: Each party's aggregate liability is capped at EUR 500,000.

positions.title: Payment terms
positions.standard: Licence fees are invoiced annually in advance and payable within thirty (30) days.

positions.title: Governing law
positions.standard: The licence is governed by the laws of Sweden.

positions.title: Assignment
positions.standard: Neither party may assign the agreement without the other's prior written consent.

positions.standard: The licensor processes personal data only as the licensee's processor and on its documented instructions.
